summary: Exact candidate 2b9bcb31501441d2cc36f3a1a3faac04084d3689 implements the requested stage-local partial projection, fixed-width PP context accumulation, one final RMSNorm, final-stage draft-KV injection, and target-plus-draft KV PD mapping. Its focused regression suite and an independent single-GPU numerical reference pass. Full original-issue resolution remains unverified because real multi-rank PP + PD serving and real Kimi-K3/DeepSeek-V4 DSpark checkpoints could not be exercised on the one-GPU prepared node.

Exact-candidate regressions: 69 passed and 12 subtests passed, covering partial/full projection equivalence, FP8 slicing structure, PP context ownership, draft KV ownership, PP consensus, and PD wire mappings. Raw output retained at /job/review-evidence-j-241a4a55ffd8/candidate-focused.log.

Also verified rejection of wrong width, empty indices, and out-of-range indices. Raw output retained at /job/review-evidence-j-241a4a55ffd8/independent-gpu-parity.log.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X executed the independent numerical projection/RMSNorm reference with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. This was single-process protocol math, not multi-rank serving.

remaining_counterexamples: A real two-or-more-rank pipeline-parallel prefill connected to a disaggregated decode instance was not executable with the single assigned GPU.
Real Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4/DSpark weights were unavailable, including execution of the quantized DeepSeek-V4 projection slice against checkpoint tensors.
Actual Mooncake and NIXL transfers carrying target KV plus final-stage-owned draft KV were not executed; only repository protocol/wire tests were available.
remaining_limitations: The node exposed one AMD Instinct MI350X, so real multi-rank PP + PD serving could not be run.
No qualifying architecture weights were available. The tiny Llama fixture cannot validate Kimi-K3 or DeepSeek-V4 DSpark semantics and was not used as proof.
No C++, HIP, or FlyDSL sources changed; repository-environment.json reports native and wheel paths as null, so no native rebuild was applicable.
